description: A Svelte 5 pivot cube linked to two inline SVG charts that always reflect the slice the grid renders. A horizontal bar chart plots each row dimension value's total ARR and drills one level deeper on each row click, from regions to countries to product families, while a line chart plots the quarterly trend across every year for the active scope; clicking a value cell highlights the bar or line point and a scope KPI strip tracks the selection. Everything is driven by the same createPivotModel output, with onCellClick wiring the selection to the charts.
keywords: svelte grid click to update chart

faq.question: How does a row click change the chart?
faq.answer: onCellClick records the clicked row's dimension path as the scope; the bar chart data is a $derived of the pivot rows whose parent is that path, so it shows the children of the selected node.

faq.question: Why inline SVG charts?
faq.answer: They keep the demo dependency-free and render from the same reactive values as the grid; any chart library or the enterprise chart components can be fed the same arrays.

faq.question: What does the scope KPI strip show?
faq.answer: Totals for the current selection, the whole slice, a region, a country or a family, computed from the same pivot rows the charts read.
